def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        col=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]!=bg:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        objs.append(cells)
    def info(cells):
      rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
      colors=sorted({grid[r][c] for r,c in cells if grid[r][c]!=1},key=lambda z:min(r for r,c in cells if grid[r][c]==z))
      return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)),colors
    infos=[info(o) for o in objs]
    groups={}
    for i,((r0,r1,c0,c1),colors) in enumerate(infos):
      mask=tuple(tuple(grid[r][c]!=bg for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
      # Collapse uniformly repeated rows and columns to compare scaled copies.
      rr=[mask[k] for k in range(len(mask)) if k==0 or mask[k]!=mask[k-1]]
      if rr:
        cc=tuple(tuple(row[k] for row in rr) for k in range(len(rr[0])) if k==0 or any(row[k]!=row[k-1] for row in rr))
      else: cc=()
      groups.setdefault(cc,[]).append(i)
    repeated=[v for v in groups.values() if len(v)>1]
    marker=None; targets=[]
    if repeated and len(groups)>1:
      targets=max(repeated,key=len)
      rest=[i for i in range(len(objs)) if i not in targets]
      if len(rest)==1: marker=rest[0]
    if marker is not None:
      mc=infos[marker][1]; tc=infos[targets[0]][1]
      if len(mc)==len(tc):
